description:
Aufgaben
• Verantwortung für die fachkompetente, individuelle und ganzheitliche Betreuung und Pflege der Patientinnen und Patienten im akutgeriatrischen Fachgebiet
• Engagement bei der Weiterentwicklung des Pflegeprozesses
• Mitwirkung bei der Qualitätsarbeit und Wirksamkeit der Pflege
• Förderung und Begleitung von Studierenden und Auszubildenden entsprechend ihres Ausbildungsstandes als Tagesbezugsperson
• Mitgestaltung einer aktiven und positiven Teamkultur

Profil
• Dipl. Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann HF/FH, DN II oder AKP (bei ausländischem Diplom mit SRK-Anerkennung)
• Fundiertes Pflegefachwissen
• Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein
• Offenheit gegenüber Veränderungen und Freude an einem lebhaften Umfeld
• Teamfähige, empathische und belastbare Persönlichkeit

• Bereich: Pflege
• Standort: Bürgerspital Solothurn
• Abteilung: Pflegedienst / Akutgeriatrie
• Pensum: 60% - 100%

Specialista infermieristico SSS/SUP, DN II o ACP (in caso di diploma straniero con riconoscimento CRS) Conoscenza approfondita dell'assistenza infermieristica Elevata consapevolezza della qualità Apertura ai cambiamenti e gioia in un ambiente vivace Personalità capace di lavorare in team, empatica e resiliente Ampia offerta di formazione, interessanti opzioni di carriera Team collegiali, clima di lavoro motivante Ospedale cantonale con elevati standard di qualità e prestazioni Contatto In caso di domande sul posto di lavoro (referenza 998): Sig.ra Sandra Ungerer Responsabile del dipartimento infermieristico Tel: +41 (0)32 627 39 57 L'ospedale civico di Soletta (BSS) garantisce l'assistenza medica di base estesa della città e della regione di Soletta. Circa 2.000 dipendenti forniscono assistenza medica e benessere ai pazienti 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7. Responsabilità Responsabilità per l'assistenza e la cura specialistica, individuale e olistica dei pazienti nel settore della geriatria acuta

Tasks Tasks Responsibility for the professional, individual and holistic care and care of patients in the acute geriatric field Engagement in the further development of the nursing process Participation in the quality work and effectiveness of nursing Support and support of students and trainees according to their level of training as day caregivers Participation in the development of an active and positive team culture
• Profile Dipl. Nursing specialist HF/FH, DN II or AKP (for foreign diplomas with SRK recognition) Well-founded nursing expertise High quality awareness Openness to change and enjoyment of a lively environment Team-oriented, empathetic and resilient personality Wide range of training options, attractive career options Collegial teams, motivating working atmosphere Cantonal hospital with high quality and performance standards Contact If you have any questions about the position (reference 998): Ms Sandra Ungerer Head of the Nursing Department Tel: +41 (0)32 627 39 57 The Citizens' Hospital Solothurn (BSS) guarantees the extended basic medical care of the city and region of Solothurn. Around 2,000 employees ensure the medical care and well-being of patients around the clock.
• Responsibilities Responsibility for the competent, individual and holistic care and care of patients in the acute geriatric specialty
